We can get this sorted quickly!

✅ **Steps:**
1. Visit any local police station for a 'Kayıp Belgesi'.
2. Bring it to Student Affairs with a new photo.

💬 Note: They won't issue a new card without the police report, so do that first!

Losing your ID is stressful, but replacing it is totally routine!

📋 **Agency:** Local Police Station -> Student Affairs
📄 Bring a loss report, photo, and active enrollment proof.

Don't worry!

residence_permit:
🎓 **Student Residence Permit (İkamet)**

Welcome to Turkey! You must apply for your Student Residence Permit within **30 days** of your arrival. 🇹🇷

✅ **Action Steps:**
1. Register at your University.
2. Buy Health Insurance.
3. Apply online at **e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr**.

💬 Have you completed your university registration yet?

🎓 **Student Ikamet Process**

The Göç İdaresi (Migration Directorate) handles all student permits.

📄 **Required Documents:**
• Passport & Entry Stamp
• Öğrenci Belgesi (Active Student Certificate)
• Health Insurance Policy
• Valid Address / Rental Contract

💬 Do you live in a rented apartment or a university dormitory?

🎓 **Securing Your Ikamet**

Don't overstay your visa! Start your online application immediately after enrolling.

⚠️ **Pro Tip:** For students, the university's International Office sometimes collects your Ikamet documents and sends them to Göç İdaresi for you. Check with them first!

💬 Want me to remind you of the exact documents you need?

🎓 **Residence Permit Details**

A Student Ikamet covers you for the duration of your studies.

📋 **Agency:** İl Göç İdaresi (Provincial Directorate of Migration)
✅ **Action:** Simply fill out the e-Ikamet form, print it, pay the card fee, and attend your appointment.

💬 Need a step-by-step guide to filling out the online e-Ikamet form?

🎓 **Applying for Student Ikamet**

If you're under 18, you'll also need a consented birth certificate and a letter of consent from your parents (apostilled!).

💬 Are you over 18, or will you need the parental consent forms?

🎓 Welcome to Turkey! Getting your Student Ikamet is honestly the most important bureaucratic step you'll take. You only have a 30-day window from your arrival date to apply online, so let's not wait around! Do you have a Turkish address yet?

🎓 Having a Student Residence Permit makes living here so much easier; it's your key to opening a bank account and getting a permanent SIM card. The very first step is hopping onto the e-Ikamet website. Should we fill out the form together?

🎓 Your Ikamet is essentially your official Turkish ID while you study! The golden rule: never let your tourist visa expire before applying. First on the checklist is your university enrollment paper and health insurance. Have you sorted those two out?

🎓 Don't forget: moving houses means you MUST update your address with Göç İdaresi within 20 days. 🏠 Your 'İkamet' is tied to your physical location. Do you have a formal rental contract notarized yet?

🎓 Applying for your residence permit is a rite of passage for every international student! 🛂 The system can be a bit slow in September, so as soon as you have your 'Öğrenci Belgesi', hit that 'e-Ikamet' website. Need the link?

🎓 Keep your 'Ikamet' card safe—it's your legal right to stay in Turkey. If you ever lose it, of course I'll help you replace it, but the bureaucratic loop is long! Do you already have your biometric photos ready for the file?
🎓 One more thing: when you go to your appointment, make sure your passport has at least 6 months of validity BEYOND your intended stay. 📅 Is your passport expiring soon?

✅ **Note:** KYK state dorms are very affordable but highly competitive, and international students can only apply during a specific window via e-Devlet.

🎓 **Securing a Dormitory (Yurt)**

If you're renting an apartment instead of a dorm, make sure the rental contract is notarized!

equivalency:
🎓 **Diploma Equivalency (Denklik)**

'Denklik' is the official recognition of your high school diploma by the Turkish Ministry of Education. It's mandatory for undergrads! 📜

✅ **Action Steps:**
1. Visit the e-Denklik online portal.
2. Upload your apostilled diploma & transcripts.
3. Book an appointment at the Ministry of Education (MEB).

💬 Have you got your diploma apostilled by your home country?

🎓 **High School Denklik Process**

Without your Denklik, your university registration is strictly temporary!

📄 **Required Documents:**
• Original Diploma + Apostille
• All High School Transcripts
• Passport copy
• Turkish translations (if not in English/Arabic)

💬 Want the link to the official e-Denklik portal?

🎓 **Equivalency Certificate**

Getting your Denklik can take 1 to 4 weeks, depending on how busy the MEB office is in September.

⚠️ **Tip:** You urgently need to apply for this as soon as you arrive in Turkey. Some universities give you exactly 30 days to hand it in.

💬 Do you need to find an official sworn translator for your documents?

🎓 **Denklik Appointment**

Once you apply online on the e-Denklik site, you'll select a Provincial Directorate of National Education (İl Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğü) to visit in person.

💬 Which city are you staying in? I can guide you to the central MEB office.

🎓 **Diploma Equivalency Rules**

Just a heads-up: Master's and PhD students do NOT need the high school Denklik. However, they must get School Recognition (Okul Tanıma) from YÖK for their Bachelor's degree.

💬 Are you applying for a Bachelor's degree or a Postgraduate program?

work_rules:
🎓 **International Student Work Permits**

Can you work while studying? Yes, but with strict rules! 💼

⚠️ **The Law:** Undergraduate students (Bachelors) can legally work part-time ONLY after completing their first year of study.

💬 Are you currently in your first year?

🎓 **Working While Studying**

Good news for Grad students! Master's and PhD students can legally work in Turkey immediately, assuming the employer applies for their work permit.

💬 Are you doing your Master's/PhD, or your Bachelor's degree?

🎓 **Legal Employment for Students**

For Bachelor's students past their first year, you are allowed to work **part-time** (max 24 hours a week).

✅ **Action Steps:**
Your employer MUST formally apply for a Student Work Permit via the Ministry of Labor.

💬 Thinking of finding a part-time job in a cafe or retail?

🎓 **Student Jobs & Freelancing**

Working illegally without a work permit can result in deportation and the cancellation of your Student Ikamet! 

📄 Always ensure your employer signs a formal part-time contract and registers you with SGK.

💬 Want to know where students typically find part-time jobs in Turkey?

🎓 **Work Permit Truths**

Remember: Your Student Ikamet does NOT automatically act as a work permit. 

✅ If a company wants to hire you, they must sponsor a Work Permit linked to your student status.

💬 Need advice on how to convince employers to sponsor part-time permits?

visa:
🎓 **Student Visa Guide**

You must apply for a Student Visa (Öğrenci Vizesi) at the Turkish Embassy/Consulate in your home country before traveling.

📄 **Key Requirements:**
• Official Acceptance Letter from your university
• Valid Passport (at least 6 months validity)
• 2 Biometric Photos
• Proof of sufficient funds & health insurance

⏳ **Duration:** Typically **3 months (90 days)**. Once you arrive in Turkey, you must apply for your Resident ID (**Ikamet**) before this expires!

💬 Need help finding the nearest Turkish consulate?

🎓 **Securing Your Visa**

Ready to come to Turkey? Your student visa is the first step.

✅ **Action Steps:**
1. Get your acceptance letter from the uni.
2. Book an appointment at the VFS Global or Turkish Consulate.
3. Pay the visa fee and submit your docs.

⚠️ **Note:** The visa is valid for **90 days**. Upon arrival, we will help you convert this into a Residence Permit card.

💬 Have you received your official University Acceptance Letter yet?

🎓 **Visa & Residency Bridge**

A student visa is your 'entry pass'. It usually lasts **3 months**.

📋 **Process:**
• **Step 1:** Get the visa at your home country.
• **Step 2:** Enter Turkey and register at uni.
• **Step 3:** Apply for your Resident ID (**Ikamet**) within 30 days of arrival.

💬 Want to know the documents needed for the Ikamet (ID) card application?

visa_already_have:
🎓 **Great! You've Got Your Visa! 🎉**

That's a huge milestone! Now let's get you settled in Turkey:

**Your next steps:**

✅ **1. Arrive in Turkey** (within 6 months of visa issue)
✅ **2. University Registration** (first week on campus)
✅ **3. Health Insurance** (required for residence permit)
✅ **4. Student Residence Permit (İkamet)** (must apply within 30 days!)

💬 Which of these would you like help with first?

Most students start with finding accommodation next – want tips on that? 🏠

🎓 **Congratulations on Your Visa Approval! 🎊**

That's fantastic! You're on track.

📋 **Quick checklist for what comes next:**

1️⃣ **Book your flight** to Turkey
2️⃣ **University Registration** (happens on campus, week 1)
3️⃣ **Get Health Insurance** (~650 TL/year minimum)
4️⃣ **Apply for İkamet** (Residence Permit) within 30 days of arrival

⏰ **Important:** Don't overstay your visa! Apply for the residence permit immediately after registering at your university.

💬 Need help with any of these steps?
visa_consulate_riyadh:
🎓 **Turkish Embassy in Riyadh 🇸🇦**

📍 **Address:** Riyadh Diplomatic Quarter, Al-Naseem District

🌐 **Appointments:** https://vize.mfa.gov.tr (book online)

📄 **Documents You'll Need:**
• Valid passport (min. 6 months)
• University acceptance letter
• Completed visa form (TCI)
• Biometric photos (2 copies, 4x5cm)
• Bank statement (proof of funds)
• Health insurance policy
• Accommodation proof

⏰ **Processing:** 5-15 business days

💡 **Riyadh Tip:** Slots fill VERY fast during May-September. Book your appointment early – don't wait until last minute!

⚠️ **During Hajj season:** Add 2-3 weeks to the timeline.

💬 Ready to book your appointment, or need help with documents?
visa_consulate_dubai:
🎓 **Turkish Consulate General in Dubai 🇦🇪**

📍 **Address:** Dubai World Trade Centre, Sheikh Zayed Road

🌐 **Appointments:** https://vize.mfa.gov.tr

📄 **Required Documents:**
• Passport (valid 6+ months)
• University acceptance letter  
• Visa application form
• 2 biometric photos (4x5cm)
• Bank statement (minimum funds)
• Health insurance certificate
• Accommodation letter/lease

⏰ **Processing:** 5-10 business days

✨ **UAE Advantage:** Some UAE nationals/residents can apply for e-Visa online instead – check if that applies to you!

💡 **Dubai Tip:** Less crowded than other Middle East konsulates, usually faster processing.

💬 Any questions about the application? Or shall we move to the next step?
visa_consulate_cairo:
🎓 **Turkish Embassy in Cairo 🇪🇬**

📍 **Address:** Maadi District, Cairo

🌐 **Appointments:** https://vize.mfa.gov.tr

📄 **Required Documents:**
• Passport (6+ months validity)
• Acceptance letter from Turkish university
• Visa application form (duly filled)
• 2 biometric photos (international standards)
• Bank statement/proof of funds
• Health insurance certificate
• Accommodation verification

⏰ **Timeline:** 5-15 business days

📢 **Cairo Embassy Note:** The embassy serves all of Egypt, so you might need to travel if you're not in Cairo.

💡 **Egyptian Students Tip:** Bring a **confirmed university acceptance letter** – it's essential! The embassy gets many inquiries about scholarships.

💬 Do you have your acceptance letter ready?
